_comment: Central registry for outbound partner, affiliate and deep links. The site never hard-codes a partner URL: pages link to /go/<slug>, and the server redirects using this file. A link is only published when status is 'active' AND approved is true. Override the whole registry with the ASKODOX_SITE_LINKS_JSON environment variable.

links.note: Not active. Do not enable until the Associates account is approved and the store tag is issued.
Point to the Google Play listing once it is public.
